{
  "module": "uart_tx_lite",
  "language": "Verilog-2001",
  "description": "Minimal UART transmitter using an external baud_tick enable.",
  "ports": [
    {"name": "clk", "direction": "input", "width": 1},
    {"name": "rst_n", "direction": "input", "width": 1, "reset": "async_active_low"},
    {"name": "start", "direction": "input", "width": 1},
    {"name": "data", "direction": "input", "width": 8},
    {"name": "baud_tick", "direction": "input", "width": 1},
    {"name": "tx", "direction": "output", "type": "reg", "width": 1},
    {"name": "busy", "direction": "output", "type": "reg", "width": 1},
    {"name": "done", "direction": "output", "type": "reg", "width": 1}
  ],
  "behavior": [
    "Idle line tx is 1.",
    "On reset: tx=1, busy=0, done=0.",
    "When start=1 in idle, latch data, assert busy, transmit one start bit 0, then 8 data bits LSB first, then one stop bit 1.",
    "Advance to the next bit only when baud_tick=1.",
    "Ignore start while busy=1.",
    "done is a one-cycle pulse asserted after the stop bit has been transmitted.",
    "When not busy, tx remains 1."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Use a clear FSM.",
    "Use synthesizable Verilog-2001 only.",
    "Do not use SystemVerilog enum.",
    "Avoid inferred latches and multiple drivers."
  ]
}
